name: zcode-plugin-workspace
description: Personal zcode desktop plugin marketplace: one plugin per top-level directory, shared libs in shared/, unified docs in docs/. Authoritative on the main branch; on feature branches a referenced plugin directory may not exist yet.

plugins.name: z-devflow-guard
plugins.description: Deterministic workflow guard for zcode dev-flow sessions: once a session enters dev-flow execution state (user prompt mentions dev-flow, the dev-flow-wf skill runs, or skill-data/dev-flow/ files are touched), any direct Agent/Task dispatch in the main session is denied via a PreToolUse hook (exit 2) until every *.status.json of the touched task directories carries a run-terminal event; the deny message carries recovery actions and a per-session waive file provides the misjudge escape hatch.

description_i18n.en: Deterministic workflow guard for zcode dev-flow sessions: once a session enters dev-flow execution state (user prompt mentions dev-flow, the dev-flow-wf skill runs, or skill-data/dev-flow/ files are touched), any direct Agent/Task dispatch in the main session is denied via a PreToolUse hook (exit 2) until every *.status.json of the touched task directories carries a run-terminal event; the deny message carries recovery actions and a per-session waive file provides the misjudge escape hatch.
description_i18n.zh-CN: zcode dev-flow 会话的确定性 workflow 守卫：会话一旦进入 dev-flow 执行态（用户输入提到 dev-flow、调用 dev-flow-wf 技能、或触碰 skill-data/dev-flow/ 产物文件），主会话用 Agent/Task 工具手工派发 subagent 即被 PreToolUse hook 以 exit 2 拒绝，强制全部派发走 CreateWorkflow；关联任务目录的全部 *.status.json 均带 run-terminal 终局事件后自动放行，拒绝消息自带恢复动作，误判经每会话一份的豁免文件解除。

plugins.name: z-subagent-workflow
plugins.description: Subagent orchestration + deterministic multi-phase workflows for zcode via the zsw CLI (pure local one-shot processes since 2.0.0 — no resident daemon): subagent lifecycle with worktree isolation, schema outputs, model routing and four-root agent .md discovery, plus built-in workflows (chain/parallel/map-reduce/scatter-gather/review-fix-loop) and custom core-contract scripts referenced by absolute .js path. Long tasks are carried by Bash run_in_background (completion rides engine-native task-notification), no polling.

description_i18n.en: Subagent orchestration + deterministic multi-phase workflows for zcode via the zsw CLI (pure local one-shot processes since 2.0.0 — no resident daemon): subagent lifecycle with worktree isolation, schema outputs, model routing and four-root agent .md discovery, plus built-in workflows (chain/parallel/map-reduce/scatter-gather/review-fix-loop) and custom core-contract scripts referenced by absolute .js path. Long tasks are carried by Bash run_in_background (completion rides engine-native task-notification), no polling.
description_i18n.zh-CN: zcode 的 subagent 编排与确定性多阶段 workflow，统一走 zsw CLI（2.0.0 起纯本地一次性执行，无常驻 daemon）：subagent 生命周期管理（worktree 隔离、schema 结构化输出、模型路由、四根 agent .md 发现）+ 内置 workflow（chain/parallel/map-reduce/scatter-gather/review-fix-loop）与自定义 core 契约脚本扩展（按 .js 绝对路径引用）。长任务由 Bash run_in_background 承载（完成唤醒借引擎原生 task-notification），零轮询。

plugins.name: z-tool-finder
plugins.description: Progressive (lazy) loading for MCP tools in zcode: per-server proxy wrappers expose only get_tool_details/call_tool meta tools, a SessionStart hook auto-takes-over user/plugin stdio servers and injects an <available-custom-tools> manifest, and a global search_tools server indexes the catalog. Fully reversible via tf restore.

description_i18n.en: Progressive (lazy) loading for MCP tools in zcode: per-server proxy wrappers expose only get_tool_details/call_tool meta tools, a SessionStart hook auto-takes-over user/plugin stdio servers and injects an <available-custom-tools> manifest, and a global search_tools server indexes the catalog. Fully reversible via tf restore.
description_i18n.zh-CN: zcode 的 MCP 工具渐进式加载：per-server 代理 wrapper 只暴露 get_tool_details/call_tool 两个 meta 工具，SessionStart hook 自动接管用户级/插件级 stdio server 并注入 <available-custom-tools> 工具清单，全局 search_tools 检索 catalog。tf restore 一键还原。

plugins.name: z-words-reminder
plugins.description: Periodic readability reminder for zcode: a UserPromptSubmit hook counts user messages per session and injects a reminder every 3rd message, asking the assistant to ground new concepts (terms, mechanism names, IDs) with one-sentence background before use, tag bare IDs with plain labels, and follow the global AGENTS.md wording lexicon.

description_i18n.en: Periodic readability reminder for zcode: a UserPromptSubmit hook counts user messages per session and injects a reminder every 3rd message, asking the assistant to ground new concepts (terms, mechanism names, IDs) with one-sentence background before use, tag bare IDs with plain labels, and follow the global AGENTS.md wording lexicon.
description_i18n.zh-CN: zcode 的周期性易读性提醒：UserPromptSubmit hook 按会话计数用户消息，每第 3 条注入一次提醒——要求对回复中本对话首次出现的概念（领域术语、机制名、编号、缩写）先用一句话铺垫背景再使用，编号带中文类型词不裸用，用语遵守全局 AGENTS.md 用语纪律词表。

plugins.name: z-quota-watch
plugins.description: Quota watch guard for zcode: a PreToolUse hook gates by per-session tool-call count (fires once the count exceeds 20, then resets) and, when the session model is a GLM plan model (account:* provider) with no live quota-wait background watch, injects the exact Bash command for the agent to start one that waits until the current 5-hour window end plus 1 minute, so the completion notification wakes the session for checkpoint handling.

description_i18n.en: Quota watch guard for zcode: a PreToolUse hook gates by per-session tool-call count (fires once the count exceeds 20, then resets) and, when the session model is a GLM plan model (account:* provider) with no live quota-wait background watch, injects the exact Bash command for the agent to start one that waits until the current 5-hour window end plus 1 minute, so the completion notification wakes the session for checkpoint handling.
description_i18n.zh-CN: zcode 的额度守望兜底：PreToolUse hook 按会话内工具调用计数门控（计数超过 20 触发一次检测并清零），检测到会话模型为 GLM 套餐模型（account:* 前缀 provider）且没有存活的 quota-wait 守望后台任务时，注入一条现成命令让 agent 用 Bash run_in_background 起一个守望——守到当前 5 小时窗口结束 +1 分钟退出，完成通知回会话后按检查点语义续接。
